mechanism: Bumetanide causes hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis which can impair glucose control and increase insulin resistance, while pioglitazone promotes fluid retention that opposes loop diuretic efficacy and increases edema/heart failure risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium, glucose, and fluid status closely; consider potassium supplementation and adjust diuretic dosing if needed; assess for worsening edema or heart failure symptoms.
